message.subject: Slice1 stage identity review hypothesis
message.body: At the next natural checkpoint, check a read-only main review hypothesis against the current source: Assert-GateStage appeared to bind stage project and non-restore Configuration/filter, but not actual -f/TargetFramework argv, and restore Configuration argv was not bound. The accepted dot plan requires actual stage argv to match project/TFM/Configuration. Please independently confirm or refute with a mutation control that changes both stage command and its matching native invocation, preserving assigned configuration; if valid, repair only the approved helper/fixtures/harness and preserve the red result. This is the existing contract, not new scope or permission for real dotnet. Rerun affected controls and the full suite after all implementation changes; freeze a scoped checkpoint/report then worker_done and idle. Main remains read-only for your owned source.
